# Red collage — Style Prompt

> The speaker drained to hard black and white, the room behind them dimmed and vignetted, and one giant red word glowing behind their head, wide as the frame. Under the face, three short lines in heavy capitals slam in one after another, the middle one red; a small red REC tag blinks at the bottom. Each beat is a new word and three new lines; nothing else changes.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **Three colours**: grey footage, white type, one red. The red is the only colour on screen.
2. **The word sits behind the person.** It is the topic of the beat in one word (≤ 5 letters is best), stretched to 98 % of the frame width, glowing, and the head cuts into it.
3. **Three lines, one rhythm.** Three short capitals lines, each its own slam, 0.13 s apart, left-aligned under the face; line two is red. Read together they are one sentence.
4. **The person stays brighter than the room.** The grade is applied to the person and room alike, then the room alone is darkened, so the speaker pops.

Not a news caption (no keyword blocks, no second line, no source tags). Not a poster (the speaker talks throughout; the type changes on the beat). Not a colour grade with titles (the red word is a layer between the room and the person, which needs the cutout).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's clip from `list_media`, set once to black and white on its wrapper (`filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.25)`, static, never tweened), with a 38 % `--latar` layer over it (the dimmed room) and a 45 % `--latar` vignette (radial, clear inside 30 %).
- **Person**: the same clip's cutout from `make_cutout` (`assets/media/cut_….webm`, same timing, cutoutTiming) with the same static grey filter but without the dimming layer, above the word. Without a cutout, put the word above the head in the empty top band and skip the "behind".
- **Stand-in** (example only): a grey room (wall, bookshelf, floor lamp, floor) in CSS gradients and a person in flat grey SVG, painted already black and white.
- **The word**: SVG `<text>` with `textLength` = 98 % of the width (`lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"`), so any brand font fits exactly; a blurred copy (stdDeviation 34) under it is the glow.
- **Bottom scrim**: `--latar` at 72 % from 52 % to 84 % of the height under the lines; lines also carry a 16 px `--latar` shadow.
- **Tag**: a 13 px red dot and monospace caps, bottom left.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--utama-di-latar` is the red of the word, line two and the tag; `--utama` is the glow behind the word. In the example both are `#ee2222`.
- `--teks` is the white of lines one and three.
- `--latar` is the dimming, the vignette, the scrim and the text shadows. The example's `--latar` is black, as in the source.
- The footage's own colours are gone by design (grey); the example's greys (`--g-*`) are fixed.
- A light brand makes the dim, the vignette and the scrim pale and the lines dark: the look turns into a pale print; it still reads.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (800) carries the word and the lines. The word: about 430 px for four letters, 360 px for five, stretched to 1,058 px wide, baseline 560 (its centre about one face-width above the face centre). The lines: 112 px, line-height 1.0, from x 54, top 1,180; a beat with longer lines drops to 100 or 84 px, all three lines the same size (the widest fits 80 % of the width, 864 px).
- `--font-isi` carries the tag: 29 px (2.7 % of the width), 600, monospace, letter-spaced 1 px. Inter 800 and IBM Plex Mono in the example; Archivo Black or Oswald 700 suit the word if the brand has no font.
- Lines are capitals and end with a full stop: "5 KM." "30 HARI." "TANPA ALAT."

## 5. Motion quality

- **Grade**: in 0.15 s at the start of the effect (the example starts graded).
- **Word**: fades in over 0.12 s (linear) while shrinking 1.12 → 1 over 0.4 s `power3.out`.
- **Lines**: each from scale 1.4 and opacity 0 to 1 in 0.16 s `power3.out`, starting 0.18 s after the beat, 0.13 s apart (0.18 / 0.31 / 0.44 s).
- **Beat end**: word and lines fade out together in 0.2 s; the next beat starts on the cut. The last beat never fades.
- **Tag**: fades in 0.15 s; the dot blinks at 2.5 Hz (on 0.4 s, 35 % for 0.4 s).
- **Cut framing**: the example alternates the framing 1.0 / 1.07 on each beat (a jump cut on the talking head); the type is outside that wrapper and never jumps.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked medium close-up | the speaker owns the frame | every beat |
| Jump cut 1.0 ↔ 1.07 on the beat | new point, same breath | each new word |
| Word shrinking 1.12 → 1 | the topic lands behind you | the hook, a new subject |
| Line slam 1.4 → 1 | each fact hits | lists of three, a claim, a price |

## 7. Native moves

- **The word behind you.** One giant red word between the room and the speaker, glowing. *Fits content like:* "LARI" for a running coach; "DISKON" for a shop; "UJIAN" for a tutor; "HUJAN" for a short story's turn; "GRATIS" for an open class.
- **Three-line slam.** Three short caps lines, the middle one red, under the face. *Fits content like:* "5 KM. / 30 HARI. / TANPA ALAT."; "SATU AKUN. / TIGA TOKO. / NOL GUDANG."; "BACA. / CATAT. / ULANGI."; "DIA PERGI. / TANPA PAMIT. / LAGI."
- **Number word.** The number itself as the red word, the lines naming what it counts. *Fits content like:* "500" pesanan; "90" menit; "7" hari; "12" murid.
- **REC tag.** A blinking red dot and a short series name, bottom left, the whole film. *Fits content like:* a channel's series; "KELAS PAGI"; "DIARI TOKO"; "EPISODE 3".

## 8. Pitfalls

- **A red word over the face**: without a cutout the word must sit above the head; with one, keep its centre one face-width above the face centre so the head cuts into its lower half, not the middle.
- **Long words**: at 98 % width a 9-letter word turns thin and short; keep it to 3–6 letters or move the long version into the lines.
- **Lines over the face**: start the lines ≥ 1.5 face-widths below the face centre (≈ y 1,180 here).
- **Colour creep**: one red only; no second accent, no coloured footage.
- **Performance**: the glow is a static blur on one text copy; the grade on video is a static wrapper filter; never animate a filter.

## Measured from the references

From the source's effect code (1080 × 1920): red (238, 34, 34); grade = luminance contrast 1.25, room at 62 % brightness, vignette 45 %; word fit to 98 % of the width, glow blur 34 px, placed at max(0.42 × its height, face centre − 1.05 × face width), scale 1.12 → 1 over 0.4 s cubic out, fade 0.12 s; lines fit to 80 % width starting at 14 % of the width (151 px), spacing 1.0 × size, from y max(50 % H, face centre + 1.55 × face width), x 5 % W, slam 1.4 → 1 in 0.16 s, 0.18 s + 0.13 s × line; line two red, shadow 8; tag monospace 2.7 % W at y 93 %, x 7 %, dot blink 2.5 Hz at 35 %; everything fades out over the last 0.2 s.

# Red collage: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.5, medium 3.5, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: the topic as one red word behind the head; three short caps lines slam in, the middle one red
- id: topiknya jadi satu kata merah di belakang kepala; tiga baris kapital pendek dihentak, baris tengah merah

## problem

- en: the pain as the red word; three lines say what goes wrong, the red line names the cause
- id: masalahnya jadi kata merah; tiga baris menyebut yang salah, baris merah menyebut penyebabnya

## fact

- en: a one-word subject in red behind; the fact split into three slammed lines, the surprising part in red
- id: satu kata subjek merah di belakang; fakta dipecah jadi tiga baris dihentak, bagian mengejutkan merah

## step

- en: the method's verb as the red word; three lines = three steps, each a short imperative
- id: kata kerja caranya jadi kata merah; tiga baris = tiga langkah, masing-masing perintah singkat

## compare

- en: the red word is the winner; lines read old way, red new way, the result
- id: kata merah adalah pemenangnya; baris: cara lama, cara baru (merah), hasilnya

## number

- en: the number itself as the giant red word; the lines say what it counts, the unit in red
- id: angkanya sendiri jadi kata merah raksasa; baris menyebut yang dihitung, satuannya merah

## proof

- en: the result word in red; three lines: who, what changed (red), in how long
- id: kata hasil merah; tiga baris: siapa, apa yang berubah (merah), berapa lama

## offer

- en: the product as the red word; lines: what it is, the price in red, the limit
- id: produknya jadi kata merah; baris: apa itu, harga merah, batasnya

## cta

- en: the action verb as the red word; lines: offer, time in red, contact; the REC tag stays, held 2 s
- id: kata kerja ajakan jadi kata merah; baris: tawaran, waktu merah, kontak; tag REC tetap, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: the lesson word in red; three lines land the takeaway, held 2 s without fading
- id: kata pelajaran merah; tiga baris menutup intinya, diam 2 dtk tanpa pudar

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Kolase merah</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #000000; --latar-2: #1a1a1a; --utama: #ee2222; --aksen: #ffffff;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #b5b5b5; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff; --teks-di-aksen: #111111;
        --utama-di-latar: #ee2222; --aksen-di-latar: #ffffff;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        /* Rekaman pengganti, sudah hitam putih (kontras 1,25): warna tetap, footage pengguna tidak ikut warna brand. */
        --g-dinding: #8d8d8d; --g-dinding2: #6f6f6f; --g-lantai: #3d3d3d; --g-rak: #4a4a4a; --g-buku1: #2c2c2c;
        --g-buku2: #9a9a9a; --g-buku3: #636363; --g-lampu: #e9e9e9; --g-kaki: #555555;
        --g-kulit: #b4b4b4; --g-kulit2: #8a8a8a; --g-rambut: #161616; --g-baju: #262626; --g-tepi: #d9d9d9;
        --g-bibir: #5d5d5d; --g-mata: #101010; --g-putih: #e6e6e6;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .cam { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: 540px 760px; }
      /* Ruang pengganti hitam putih: dinding, rak buku, lampu berdiri, lantai. */
      .ruang { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g-dinding2), var(--g-dinding) 45%, var(--g-dinding2)); }
      .lantai { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 1500px; bottom: 0; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g-lantai) 0 90px, var(--g-rak) 90px 96px); }
      .rak { position: absolute; left: 820px; top: 420px; width: 320px; height: 1100px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(var(--g-rak) 0 14px, transparent 14px 210px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g-buku1) 0 26px, var(--g-buku2) 26px 44px, var(--g-buku3) 44px 76px, var(--g-buku1) 76px 90px); }
      .lampu { position: absolute; left: 60px; top: 300px; width: 300px; height: 190px; background: var(--g-lampu); clip-path: polygon(16% 0, 84% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
      .kaki { position: absolute; left: 200px; top: 490px; width: 14px; height: 1050px; background: var(--g-kaki); }
      /* Gelapkan ruang (orang tetap terang) dan vinyet ke --latar. */
      .redup { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 38%, transparent); }
      .vinyet { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 30; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 70% at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 45%, transparent) 100%); }
      .scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 31; background: linear-gradient(transparent 52%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 72%, transparent) 64%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 72%, transparent) 84%, transparent); }
      .orang { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -120px; width: 1080px; height: 2040px; z-index: 20; overflow: visible; }
      .kulit { fill: var(--g-kulit); } .kulit2 { fill: var(--g-kulit2); } .rambut { fill: var(--g-rambut); } .baju { fill: var(--g-baju); }
      .tepi { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-tepi); stroke-width: 9; } .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-rambut); stroke-width: 12; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .hidung { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-kulit2); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .putih { fill: var(--g-putih); } .mata { fill: var(--g-mata); } .bibir { fill: var(--g-bibir); }
      /* Kata raksasa merah di belakang kepala: lebar 98 % frame, berpendar. */
      .kata { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; z-index: 10; overflow: visible; visibility: hidden; }
      .kata text { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; fill: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .kata .pendar { fill: var(--utama); opacity: 0.85; }
      /* Tiga baris dihentak di bawah wajah, kiri 5 %; baris kedua merah. */
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 40; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .baris { position: absolute; left: 54px; top: 1180px; font: 800 var(--uk, 112px)/1 var(--font-judul); color: var(--teks); white-space: nowrap;
        text-shadow: 0 4px 16px color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, transparent); }
      .baris div { transform-origin: 50% 50%; width: max-content; }
      .baris .m { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .tag { position: absolute; left: 76px; top: 1768px; z-index: 45; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font: 600 29px/1 var(--font-isi);
        color: var(--utama-di-latar); letter-spacing: 1px; white-space: pre; }
      .titik { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--utama-di-latar); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="cam" id="cam">
        <!-- Footage pengguna: satu <video> klip upl_… dari list_media hitam putih (filter statis grayscale(1) contrast(1.25) di wrapper)
             di bawah lapisan .redup; cutout video cutout cut_… dari make_cutout di tempat .orang, kata merah di antaranya. -->
        <div class="ruang"><div class="lantai"></div><div class="rak"></div><div class="kaki"></div><div class="lampu"></div></div>
        <div class="redup"></div>
        <svg class="kata" id="k1" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><text class="pendar" x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="430" filter="url(#blur)">LARI</text><text x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="430">LARI</text></svg>
        <svg class="kata" id="k2" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><text class="pendar" x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="360" filter="url(#blur)">CAPEK</text><text x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="360">CAPEK</text></svg>
        <svg class="kata" id="k3" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><text class="pendar" x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="360" filter="url(#blur)">PELAN</text><text x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="360">PELAN</text></svg>
        <svg class="kata" id="k4" viewBox="0 0 1080 1920"><text class="pendar" x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="430" filter="url(#blur)">IKUT</text><text x="540" y="560" text-anchor="middle" textLength="1058" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs" font-size="430">IKUT</text></svg>
        <svg class="orang" viewBox="0 0 1080 2040">
          <defs><filter id="blur" x="-20%" y="-40%" width="140%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="34" /></filter></defs>
          <path class="rambut" d="M330 900 C300 1100 280 1250 330 1330 L750 1330 C800 1250 780 1100 750 900 Z" />
          <path class="baju" d="M120 2040 L150 1380 Q175 1220 330 1180 L440 1150 Q540 1210 640 1150 L750 1180 Q905 1220 930 1380 L960 2040 Z" />
          <path class="kulit" d="M330 1180 L440 1150 Q540 1225 640 1150 L750 1180 L720 1250 Q540 1330 360 1250 Z" />
          <path class="tepi" d="M352 1236 Q540 1330 728 1236" />
          <path class="kulit2" d="M478 990 L474 1150 Q540 1200 606 1150 L602 990 Z" />
          <g id="kepala">
            <path class="kulit" d="M540 660 C646 660 702 742 702 868 C702 990 636 1070 540 1070 C444 1070 378 990 378 868 C378 742 434 660 540 660 Z" />
            <path class="rambut" d="M352 1000 C320 760 410 600 548 600 C686 600 768 740 730 1000 C716 860 690 760 640 712 C590 760 470 780 400 760 C372 820 360 900 352 1000 Z" />
            <path class="alis" d="M438 820 q34 -16 70 -6 M572 814 q36 -10 70 6" />
            <g id="mata"><ellipse class="putih" cx="474" cy="866" rx="29" ry="16" /><ellipse class="putih" cx="606" cy="866" rx="29" ry="16" />
              <circle class="mata" cx="476" cy="866" r="13" /><circle class="mata" cx="604" cy="866" r="13" /></g>
            <path class="hidung" d="M540 884 q-10 40 -20 52 q14 9 30 2" />
            <ellipse class="bibir" id="mulut" cx="540" cy="986" rx="44" ry="20" />
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="vinyet"></div><div class="scrim"></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><div class="baris"><div>5 KM.</div><div class="m">30 HARI.</div><div>TANPA ALAT.</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s2" data-role="problem"><div class="baris"><div>BUKAN KAKI.</div><div class="m">NAPASMU</div><div>YANG KALAH.</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s3" data-role="step"><div class="baris" style="--uk: 100px"><div>LARI PELAN.</div><div class="m">BISA NGOBROL.</div><div>BARU NAMBAH.</div></div></div>
      <div class="scene" id="s4" data-role="cta"><div class="baris" style="--uk: 84px"><div>IKUT GRATIS.</div><div class="m">SABTU 06.00</div><div>Chat 0812-3456-7890</div></div></div>
      <div class="tag"><div class="titik" id="titik"></div><span>REC  ·  KLUB LARI PAGI</span></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat); titik REC berkedip 2,5 kali per detik.
      const JEDA = [[3.5, 3.9], [7.3, 7.7], [11.1, 11.5], [14.0, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 12.9) * Math.sin(t * 3.7 + 0.4)), transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 2 * Math.sin(t * 1.1), y: 8 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + 1), svgOrigin: "540 1100" });
        const k = (t % 3.1) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#titik", { opacity: Math.floor(t * 2.5) % 2 ? 0.35 : 1 });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => hidup(jam.t) }, 0);
      tl.fromTo(".tag", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: "none" }, 0);
      // Satu ketukan: kata merah muncul 0,12 dtk sambil mengecil 1,12 -> 1 dalam 0,4 dtk; tiga baris dihentak 1,4 -> 1
      // dalam 0,16 dtk, mulai 0,18 dtk, jarak 0,13 dtk; semua pudar 0,2 dtk di akhir ketukan. Potongan berikutnya lompat bingkai.
      const KETUK = [["#s1", "#k1", 0, 3.8, 1], ["#s2", "#k2", 3.8, 7.6, 1.07], ["#s3", "#k3", 7.6, 11.4, 1], ["#s4", "#k4", 11.4, 15, 1.07]];
      KETUK.forEach(([s, k, a, b, zoom], i) => {
        tl.set(k, { visibility: "visible" }, a).set(s, { visibility: "visible" }, a);
        if (i) tl.set(KETUK[i - 1][0], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set(KETUK[i - 1][1], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set("#cam", { scale: zoom }, a);
        tl.fromTo(k, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: "none" }, a);
        tl.fromTo(k, { scale: 1.12 }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "power3.out", transformOrigin: "540px 440px" }, a);
        document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelectorAll(".baris div").forEach((el, j) => {
          tl.fromTo(el, { scale: 1.4, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.16, ease: "power3.out" }, a + 0.18 + 0.13 * j);
        });
        if (i < KETUK.length - 1) tl.to([k, document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelector(".baris")], { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, b - 0.2);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

      html, body { width: 1920px; height: 1080px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }

        repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g-buku1) 0 26px, var(--g-buku2) 26px 44px, var(--g-buku3) 44px 76px, var(--g-buku1) 76px 90px); }
      .lampu { position: absolute; left: 160px; top: 110px; width: 260px; height: 160px; background: var(--g-lampu); clip-path: polygon(16% 0, 84% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }
      .kaki { position: absolute; left: 284px; top: 270px; width: 12px; height: 640px; background: var(--g-kaki); }
      /* Gelapkan ruang (orang tetap terang) dan vinyet ke --latar. */
      .redup { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 38%, transparent); }
      .vinyet { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 30; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 70% at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 45%, transparent) 100%); }
      .scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 31; background: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 72%, transparent) 0, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 55%, transparent) 42%, transparent 58%); }
      .orang { position: absolute; left: 915px; top: -68px; width: 670px; height: 1265px; z-index: 20; overflow: visible; }
      .kulit { fill: var(--g-kulit); } .kulit2 { fill: var(--g-kulit2); } .rambut { fill: var(--g-rambut); } .baju { fill: var(--g-baju); }
      .tepi { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-tepi); stroke-width: 9; } .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-rambut); stroke-width: 12; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .hidung { fill: none; stroke: var(--g-kulit2); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .putih { fill: var(--g-putih); } .mata { fill: var(--g-mata); } .bibir { fill: var(--g-bibir); }
      /* Kata raksasa merah di belakang kepala: lebar 98 % frame, berpendar. */
      .kata { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1920px; height: 1080px; z-index: 10; overflow: visible; visibility: hidden; }
      .kata text { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; fill: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .kata .pendar { fill: var(--utama); opacity: 0.85; }

      .baris { position: absolute; left: 96px; top: 560px; font: 800 var(--uk, 104px)/1 var(--font-judul); color: var(--teks); white-space: nowrap;

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Orang pengganti: kepala mengangguk pelan, berkedip, mulut bicara (jeda di antara kalimat); titik REC berkedip 2,5 kali per detik.
      const JEDA = [[3.5, 3.9], [7.3, 7.7], [11.1, 11.5], [14.0, 15]];
      function hidup(t) {
        const diam = JEDA.some(([a, b]) => t > a && t < b);
        gsap.set("#mulut", { scaleY: diam ? 0.15 : 0.2 + 0.8 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 12.9) * Math.sin(t * 3.7 + 0.4)), transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#kepala", { rotation: 2 * Math.sin(t * 1.1), y: 8 * Math.sin(t * 2.3 + 1), svgOrigin: "540 1100" });
        const k = (t % 3.1) / 0.16;
        gsap.set("#mata", { scaleY: k < 1 ? 1 - 0.9 * Math.sin(k * Math.PI) : 1, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" });
        gsap.set("#titik", { opacity: Math.floor(t * 2.5) % 2 ? 0.35 : 1 });
      }
      const jam = { t: 0 };
      hidup(0);
      tl.to(jam, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => hidup(jam.t) }, 0);
      tl.fromTo(".tag", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: "none" }, 0);
      // Satu ketukan: kata merah muncul 0,12 dtk sambil mengecil 1,12 -> 1 dalam 0,4 dtk; tiga baris dihentak 1,4 -> 1
      // dalam 0,16 dtk, mulai 0,18 dtk, jarak 0,13 dtk; semua pudar 0,2 dtk di akhir ketukan. Potongan berikutnya lompat bingkai.
      const KETUK = [["#s1", "#k1", 0, 3.8, 1], ["#s2", "#k2", 3.8, 7.6, 1.07], ["#s3", "#k3", 7.6, 11.4, 1], ["#s4", "#k4", 11.4, 15, 1.07]];
      KETUK.forEach(([s, k, a, b, zoom], i) => {
        tl.set(k, { visibility: "visible" }, a).set(s, { visibility: "visible" }, a);
        if (i) tl.set(KETUK[i - 1][0], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set(KETUK[i - 1][1], { visibility: "hidden" }, a).set("#cam", { scale: zoom }, a);
        tl.fromTo(k, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: "none" }, a);
        tl.fromTo(k, { scale: 1.12 }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "power3.out", transformOrigin: "960px 250px" }, a);
        document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelectorAll(".baris div").forEach((el, j) => {
          tl.fromTo(el, { scale: 1.4, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.16, ease: "power3.out" }, a + 0.18 + 0.13 * j);
        });
        if (i < KETUK.length - 1) tl.to([k, document.getElementById(s.slice(1)).querySelector(".baris")], { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, b - 0.2);
      });
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines.main = tl;
    </script>
